name: Anaheim Fall 2018
information:
* This is a two day competition.  The first day will be quiet events and the second day will be loud events.
* Please do not register for blindfolded events if you cannot solve cubes blindfolded.
* If you choose to compete in clock, please familiarize yourself with the regulations regarding clock so we do not run into problems on the day of the competition.
* All donations will be given to the Canyon High School Band & Colorguard.
* Spectators may attend free of charge.
